# Propel

> Propel simplifies benefits management by helping low-income households check EBT balances, discover grocery deals, receive real-time benefit alerts, and protect against fraud.

Propel is a mobile app and platform dedicated to making government benefits like SNAP, WIC, TANF, and Medicaid more accessible and secure. The platform combines balance checking, personalized offers, fraud prevention tools, and educational resources to empower benefits recipients across all U.S. states and territories.

## Key Topics

- EBT balance checking
- SNAP benefits
- WIC benefits
- TANF
- Medicaid
- EBT card security
- Fraud prevention
- Benefits alerts
- Grocery deals and coupons
- Mobile app
- Financial security
- Benefits management
- Government benefits
- EBT theft prevention
- State-specific guides

## Core Features

- [Propel | Your benefits, made easier](https://www.propel.app): Propel homepage: EBT balance checking and benefits management app
- [Balance checking](https://www.propel.app/balance-checking): Propel's EBT balance checking feature with transaction history
- [Offers](https://www.propel.app/offers): EBT grocery deals and coupons through Propel app
- [Benefits updates](https://www.propel.app/benefits-updates): SNAP, WIC, EBT alerts and benefits notification feature
- [Security](https://www.propel.app/security): EBT card locking and fraud prevention security features

## Benefits Guides & Education

- [The Propel blog](https://www.propel.app/blog): Propel blog covering SNAP, WIC, EBT, and Medicaid benefits
- [Guides to EBT & SNAP in my state](https://www.propel.app/snap/state): State-specific SNAP and EBT eligibility guides and resources
- [The Propel blog (SNAP)](https://www.propel.app/snap): SNAP benefits guides and food stamp eligibility information
- [Will a Government Shutdown Affect SNAP In 2026? | Propel](https://www.propel.app/snap/government-shutdown): Government shutdown impact on SNAP and WIC benefits timing

## Fraud Prevention & Security

- [Stop EBT Theft Hub](https://www.propel.app/stoptheft): EBT theft prevention hub and fraud protection resources
- [EBT Theft: How It Happens And What To Do If Your EBT Benefits Are Stolen](https://www.propel.app/snap/ebt-theft-how-it-happens-and-replacing-stolen-benefits): Guide to EBT theft prevention and stolen benefits recovery
